# cli

> Command-line interfaces: flags, arguments and subcommands, with --help written for you.

[source](../../registry/cli.pkg) · truck

```
use std
use rt
use cli

let c = cli_new("greet", "say hello")
cli_flag(c, "loud", "l", "shout it")
cli_num(c, "times", "n", "N", "how many times", 1)
cli_arg(c, "name", "who to greet")
cli_parse_or_exit(c, argv)

let msg = str_concat("hello, ", cli_get(c, "name"))
for i = 1 to cli_int(c, "times")
  print msg
end
```

```
$ greet --help
greet: say hello

Usage:
  greet [flags] <name>

Arguments:
  name  who to greet

Flags:
  -l, --loud     shout it
  -n, --times N  how many times (default 1)
  -h, --help     show this help
```

See [cli/cli](cli/cli.md) for everything it does.
